sealed_note: a = 0 is a TOPOLOGICAL discontinuity, not the small-aperture limit: a sealed one-node divider disconnects room B exactly, so H_B == 0 and the inter-room level difference is -inf. Rows with sealed = true are kept in the dataset but MUST be excluded from every continuous-coordinate fit and from training (the trainer filters them via config_kinds).
